edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the externally fetched factory bridge address in onlyBridgeOwner.
msg.sender is compared against the externally fetched factory admin address in onlyBridgeAdminOwner.
onlyBridgeOwner performs the external ITokenFactory(factory()).bridge() call that backs its authorization check.
mint is gated by the onlyBridgeOwner modifier whose check is an external factory call.
burn path is gated by the onlyBridgeOwner modifier logic.
_burn re-reads the bridge address through an external factory call before mutating state.
increaseCap is gated by onlyBridgeAdminOwner which trusts an external factory call.
_burn performs the external ITokenFactory(factory()).bridge() call inside a state-changing function, enabling reentrancy through a malicious factory.
msg.sender is the implicit sender passed to _transfer by transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when reading and updating allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is the account burned by burn.
msg.sender is used as spender in burnFrom allowance check.
transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction of amount from the cached allowance.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the stored allowance before calling _approve.
decreaseAllowance computes an unchecked allowance subtraction.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
increaseCap adds cap_ to the _cap accounting variable.
mint checks _cap then calls _mint, whose authorization relies on the bridge owner role.
burn delegates to _burn using msg.sender as account.
burnFrom reduces the allowance via _approve before burning.
burnFrom delegates token destruction to _burn.
_transfer performs an unchecked subtraction of amount from the cached sender balance.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_mint decreases the _cap accounting variable by the minted amount.
_mint increases the recipient entry in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping for owner and spender.
initialize delegates all setup work to __Token_init.
initialize is protected by the initializer modifier which reads and sets _initialized.
EthereumTokenMintable.initialize relies on the initializer guard reading _initialized.
__Token_init calls the external factory owner() accessor to obtain the mint recipient.
The externally fetched owner address is used as the recipient in _mint.
__Token_init assigns the factory address to _factory.
factory() returns the stored _factory state variable.
factory_ parameter is written into the _factory state variable.
cap_ parameter is added to the _cap accounting variable.
amount parameter determines how much _mint adds to supply and balances.
to parameter is the recipient account in _mint.
account parameter is the burn source in _burn.
spender parameter is stored in the _allowances mapping by _approve.
recipient parameter receives the balance in _transfer.
sender parameter is the debited account in _transfer.
currentAllowance local is the operand of the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
senderBalance local is the operand of the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
currentAllowance local is the operand of the unchecked subtraction in decreaseAllowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The factory_ parameter only flows into the _factory state variable and factory() lookups inside __Token_init, so it is folded into that core function.
The amount parameter of mint is consumed by _mint, which is the core state-changing function for supply.
The to parameter is used solely as the _mint recipient and can be merged into _mint.
cap_ is only used in the arithmetic write _cap += cap_, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
account is only passed as the burning account into _burn and carries no separate semantics.
spender is only stored in the allowance mapping by _approve.
recipient is only consumed as the credited account inside _transfer.
sender is only consumed as the debited account inside _transfer.
This local exists only to feed the unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
This local exists only to feed the unchecked balance subtraction in _transfer.
This local exists only to feed the unchecked allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
